mapper.sql: CASE WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%DeptController%' THEN '部门管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%RoleController%' THEN '角色管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%UserController%' THEN '用户管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%CourseController%' THEN '课程管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%ActivityController%' THEN '活动管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%ClueController%' THEN '线索管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%BusinessController%' THEN '商机管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%CustomerController%' THEN '客户管理' WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%UploadController%' THEN '文件上传' ELSE NULL END

CASE WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%DeptController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addDept' THEN '新增部门' WHEN 'updateDept' THEN '修改部门' WHEN 'deleteDept' THEN '删除部门' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%RoleController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addRole' THEN '新增角色' WHEN 'updateRole' THEN '修改角色' WHEN 'deleteRole' THEN '删除角色' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%UserController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addUser' THEN '新增用户' WHEN 'updateUser' THEN '修改用户' WHEN 'deleteUsers' THEN '删除用户' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%CourseController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addCourse' THEN '新增课程' WHEN 'updateCourse' THEN '修改课程' WHEN 'deleteCourse' THEN '删除课程' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%ActivityController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addActivity' THEN '新增活动' WHEN 'updateActivity' THEN '修改活动' WHEN 'deleteActivity' THEN '删除活动' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%ClueController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addClue' THEN '新增线索' WHEN 'assignClue' THEN '分配线索' WHEN 'trackClue' THEN '跟进线索' WHEN 'markFalseClue' THEN '伪线索上报' WHEN 'convertToBusiness' THEN '转商机' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%BusinessController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addBusiness' THEN '新增商机' WHEN 'assignBusiness' THEN '分配商机' WHEN 'trackBusiness' THEN '跟进商机' WHEN 'backToPool' THEN '踢回公海' WHEN 'convertToCustomer' THEN '转客户' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%CustomerController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'addCustomer' THEN '新增客户' WHEN 'updateCustomer' THEN '修改客户' ELSE l.method_name END WHEN l.class_name LIKE '%UploadController%' THEN CASE l.method_name WHEN 'upload' THEN '图片上传' ELSE l.method_name END ELSE l.method_name END
mapper.select:
SELECT l.id, l.operate_user_id, l.operate_time, l.class_name, l.method_name, l.method_params, l.return_value, l.cost_time, u.name AS operate_user_name, AS operate_module, AS operate_type FROM operate_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON l.operate_user_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{logQueryDto.operateUserName}, '%')
AND LIKE CONCAT('%', #{logQueryDto.operateModule}, '%')
AND LIKE CONCAT('%', #{logQueryDto.operateType}, '%')
ORDER BY l.operate_time DESC, l.id DESC
